known_limitations: Night-time Low-Light Degradation: Photos taken under inadequate street lighting (<5 lux) exhibit 18% lower confidence in asphalt depth detection.
Serverless In-Memory Rate Limiter: The current 5 req/min/IP rate limiter is stored in-memory and resets on Vercel cold restarts; production requires Redis (Upstash).
2D Single-Perspective Depth Ambiguity: Without LiDAR or multi-angle photogrammetry, pothole depth is estimated from shadow gradients and surrounding aggregate size.
Rapid Coastal Micro-Climate Shifts: Sudden sea breeze accelerations from the Bay of Bengal can clear particulate matter 2 hours faster than regional 24h numerical weather models predict.
